# Backpacker's Pantry

> > Freeze-dried camping meals and backpacking food with 10-year shelf life, featuring organic ingredients and lightweight options for outdoor adventures.

Backpacker's Pantry is a Boulder, Colorado-based company specializing in freeze-dried meals for backpacking, camping, and emergency preparedness. The brand is committed to sustainability through partnerships with 1% for the Planet and TerraCycle, and produces popular products like Three Cheese Mac & Cheese, Pad Thai, and Astronaut Ice Cream.

## Key Topics

- Freeze-dried meals
- Backpacking food
- Lightweight camping meals
- Emergency food storage

## Products & Meals

- [What Makes Backpacker's Pantry the Best Camping Food?](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/what-makes-backpackers-pantry-the-best-camping-food): Brand overview highlighting organic ingredients and TerraCycle partnership
- [Three Cheese Mac & Cheese](https://backpackerspantry.com/products/three-cheese-mac-cheese): Freeze-dried Three Cheese Mac & Cheese with 10-year shelf life
- [Blueberry Peach Crisp](https://backpackerspantry.com/products/blueberry-peach-crisp): Freeze-dried Blueberry Peach Crisp dessert with southern-inspired recipe

## Emergency Preparedness & Survival

- [Our Guide to Emergency Food Storage](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/our-guide-to-emergency-food-storage): FEMA-aligned emergency food storage guide with survival meal kits
- [5 Expert Survival Tips](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/5-expert-survival-tips): Wilderness survival guide covering shelter, fire, and water purification

## Hiking & Backpacking Guides

- [Minimalist Hiking: Three Things You Need to Know to Get Started](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/three-things-about-minimalist-hiking): Beginner's guide to ultralight backpacking and minimalist hiking
- [The 6 Best Hiking Gifts for Hitting the Trail](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/6-best-hiking-gifts-for-hitting-the-trail): Gift guide featuring Darn Tough socks and hiking essentials for trails
- [Denver's Top 5 Day Hikes](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/denver-top-5-day-hikes): Denver hiking guide featuring Mills Lake and Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Find Love On The Trail - 6 Romantic Hikes](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/romantic-hikes): Valentine's Day hiking guide with customer stories from trails

## Food Science & History

- [The Ancient History of Freeze-Drying](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/the-ancient-history-of-freeze-drying-food): Aymara people's ancient freeze-drying techniques in Andes Mountains

## Sustainability & Company Initiatives

- [American Outdoor Products Goes Solar](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/solar-panel-blog-post): 160 kW solar array installation with Namasté Solar in Boulder, Colorado
- [Mobilizing for Monuments Road Trip Film released!](https://backpackerspantry.com/blogs/news/mobilizing-for-monuments-road-trip-film-release-on-april-18-2024): Conservation Alliance film on national monuments advocacy in western US
